sources.entry: VerticalBar - macOS application to add a vertical bar to Dock.

summary.one_liner: A macOS project that builds separator apps which add a vertical or horizontal bar to the Dock, styled like the default one.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes an Xcode project that produces macOS applications meant to appear as a bar in the Dock. It offers three variants named Vertical, LeftBar and RightBar, for when the Dock sits at the bottom, left or right edge of the screen. The build is exported by archiving in Xcode and choosing "Copy App", which yields a standalone application. You can make multiple copies of that application. When one is opened, it closes itself after 10 seconds, giving you time to choose "Keep in Dock". A screenshot section is present but has no image in the text provided.
use_cases: Add a separator bar to the macOS Dock
Create vertical divider in the Dock
Build a left or right side Dock bar
how_to_run: Open the project in Xcode 9 or later
Select the desired version: Vertical, LeftBar or RightBar
Click the archived application and select Distribute App
Choose Copy App and select a local directory
Open the exported application and click Keep in Dock within 10 seconds
notable: Three variants for Dock positioned at bottom, left or right
Exported apps can be copied and reused as separate Dock bars
Self-closing after 10 seconds to allow Keep in Dock
caveats: Requires Xcode 9 or later and a Mac to build
Launched apps close after 10 seconds, so the Keep in Dock step must be done quickly
README does not state a maintenance status or macOS version support
